papers.title: Direction of ESCRT-III-dependent membrane bending emerges from bilayer asymmetry
papers.translated_title: ESCRT-III依赖的膜弯曲方向源于双分子层不对称性
papers.author: Tran, J.
papers.summary: ESCRT-III is the cell's principal machinery for reverse-topology membrane scission, cutting necks from within. Yet purified ESCRT-III predominantly assembles on the outside of membranes and bends them the opposite way. How one polymer chooses its direction is a long-standing paradox. Here, we show that ESCRT-III supplies the force, but bilayer asymmetry sets the direction. In budding yeast, sphingolipid asymmetry is required for efficient intraluminal vesicle formation: without it, cargo sorting is impaired and endosomal intermediates accumulate. In reconstituted membranes, imposing either lipid or protein asymmetry across the bilayer is sufficient to orient ESCRT-III-driven deformation. Leaflet-resolved fluorescence-lifetime imaging reveals that both act through a single mechanism: unequal lipid packing between leaflets generates differential tensile stress that dictates which way the membrane bends. Reconstituted membranes are typically symmetric; cellular membranes are not. This resolves the reverse-topology paradox and identifies bilayer asymmetry as a directional cue available to any membrane-remodeling machine.
papers.translated_summary: ESCRT-III是细胞执行反向拓扑膜剪切、从内部切割膜颈的主要机器。然而，纯化的ESCRT-III主要组装在膜的外侧，并向相反方向弯曲膜。一种聚合物如何选择其方向，是一个长期存在的悖论。在此，我们表明ESCRT-III提供力，但双分子层不对称决定方向。在芽殖酵母中，鞘脂不对称是高效腔内囊泡形成所必需的：缺乏它时，货物分选受损，内体中间体积累。在重构膜中，施加脂质或蛋白质跨双分子层的不对称足以定向ESCRT-III驱动的形变。小叶分辨的荧光寿命成像揭示，两者通过单一机制起作用：小叶之间不等的脂质堆积产生差异拉伸应力，从而决定膜向哪个方向弯曲。重构膜通常是 symmetric 的；细胞膜则不是。这解决了反向拓扑悖论，并将双分子层不对称识别为任何膜重塑机器都可利用的方向线索。

papers.title: Dynamic gene-body chromatin accessibility is associated with a stage-dependent transcriptional upregulation during germination of fission yeast spores
papers.translated_title: 动态基因体染色质可及性与裂殖酵母孢子萌发过程中阶段依赖性转录上调相关
papers.author: Shogaki, Y.
papers.summary: Variations in the expression of histone genes influence the process of breaking dormancy in fission yeast spore cells. Since histones play a crucial role in chromatin organization, alterations in their expression impact chromatin states during spore germination, where such changes are vital. Although chromatin accessibility state has been studied in proliferating cells, there has been no specific research on spores. In this study, using ATAC-seq to examine chromatin accessibility in fission yeast spores, we found that ATAC-seq peaks frequently appeared as broad regions in gene-body in addition to promoter-linked narrow regions. Narrow peaks representing high chromatin accessibility at transcription start sites (TSSs) observed in proliferating cells were maintained in dormant spores as well as germinating spores, whereas broad peaks that cover gene-body were redistributed among different genes as germination progressed. The transition of broad open chromatin on gene-body was often linked with a stage-dependent transcriptional upregulation determined by scRNA-seq throughout dormancy breaking. Thus, the spore-specific chromatin alterations contribute to transcriptional changes observed during germination.
papers.translated_summary: 组蛋白基因表达的变化影响裂殖酵母孢子细胞休眠打破的过程。由于组蛋白在染色质组织中发挥关键作用，其表达的改变会影响孢子萌发过程中的染色质状态，而这些变化至关重要。尽管染色质可及性状态已在增殖细胞中得到研究，但尚无针对孢子的专门研究。在本研究中，利用ATAC-seq检测裂殖酵母孢子中的染色质可及性，我们发现ATAC-seq峰除了出现在启动子相关的窄区域外，还频繁出现在基因体中的宽区域。在增殖细胞中观察到的代表转录起始位点（TSSs）高染色质可及性的窄峰在休眠孢子和萌发孢子中均得以维持，而覆盖基因体的宽峰则随着萌发进展在不同基因之间重新分布。基因体上宽开放染色质的转变通常与由scRNA-seq确定的整个休眠打破过程中阶段依赖性的转录上调相关联。因此，孢子特异性的染色质改变促成了萌发过程中观察到的转录变化。

papers.title: Do single-cell foundation models need 512 dimensions for one number?
papers.translated_title: 单细胞基础模型真的需要一个数字就用512维来表示吗？
papers.author: Zhang, L.
papers.summary: Single-cell foundation models represent counts through high-dimensional value embeddings or ranked feature tokens. We asked how many dimensions counts need and what network computes. In a controlled Transformer, a four-dimensional value track separated from a wide gene-identity backbone retains nearly all masked-prediction net gain; a straight line replaces pretrained value curves with little transfer loss. Across evaluated cohorts, clamping detected-gene values retains most gain in annotation, surface-protein prediction and perturbation-shift consistency, consistent with the prevalence of single-molecule counts. A two-feature encoder combining tie-free rank and within-cell standardized magnitude improves controlled retraining and preserves annotation when grafted onto pretrained scGPT. Gene offsets and three linear cell-level scalars approximate masked prediction and predict responses to count thinning; depth leads in the controlled model, while cell type leads in scGPT. Matched controls show that attribution, attention, dictionary and probe readouts can reflect depth, gene frequency, hub degree or directions that transfer little output.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞基础模型通过高维值嵌入或排序特征标记来表示计数。我们探究了计数需要多少维度以及网络计算了什么。在一个受控Transformer中，与宽基因身份主干分离的四维值轨道保留了几乎全部掩码预测净增益；一条直线替代预训练值曲线，迁移损失很小。在所评估的队列中，钳制检测到的基因值在注释、表面蛋白预测和扰动偏移一致性中保留了大部分增益，这与单分子计数的普遍性一致。一个结合无并列排序和细胞内标准化幅度的双特征编码器改善了受控重训练，并在移植到预训练scGPT上时保留了注释性能。基因偏移和三个线性细胞级标量近似掩码预测，并预测对计数稀释的响应；在受控模型中深度领先，而在scGPT中细胞类型领先。匹配对照表明，归因、注意力、字典和探针读出可以反映深度、基因频率、枢纽度或迁移输出很少的方向。

papers.title: Phase-separated FRM proteins create signaling subdomains in inter-organelle junctions
papers.translated_title: 相分离的FRM蛋白在细胞器间连接处形成信号传导亚结构域
papers.author: Deng, H.
papers.summary: Endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane junctions (EPJs) house the calcium-signaling machinery that mediates calcium; release from the ER and its reentry into the ER. How these opposing functions are coordinated at EPJs is unknown. Here we show that neuronal EPJs are patch-like membrane contacts partitioned into discrete, adjacent subdomains containing the calcium-release and calcium-reentry machineries. Through a forward genetic screen, we identified the evolutionarily conserved FERM-family proteins FRM-4 and FRM-1 as central organizers of this architecture. FRM-4 and FRM-1 assemble EPJs by bridging the membranes, recruiting calcium-signaling components, and establishing the subdomains. Loss of FRM proteins disrupts both signaling domains and attenuates neuronal calcium responses and plasticity. FRM proteins and calcium-signaling molecules undergo phase separation at EPJs in vivo. Purified FRM proteins phase separate in vitro and suffice to partition calcium channels into their correct subdomains. Thus, phase separation creates molecular and functional subdomains at organelle junctions.
papers.translated_summary: 内质网-质膜连接（EPJs）容纳介导钙信号传导的钙信号机制，该机制调控钙从内质网释放及其再进入内质网。这些相反功能在EPJs处如何协调尚不清楚。本研究表明，神经元EPJs是斑块状膜接触，被分隔为离散的相邻亚结构域，分别包含钙释放和钙再进入机制。通过正向遗传筛选，我们鉴定出进化上保守的FERM家族蛋白FRM-4和FRM-1是该结构的中枢组织者。FRM-4和FRM-1通过桥接膜、招募钙信号组分并建立亚结构域来组装EPJs。FRM蛋白缺失会破坏两个信号结构域，并减弱神经元钙反应和可塑性。FRM蛋白与钙信号分子在体内EPJs处发生相分离。纯化的FRM蛋白在体外发生相分离，并足以将钙通道分配至正确的亚结构域。因此，相分离在细胞器连接处创建了分子和功能亚结构域。

papers.title: A dynamic proteomic HECT E3 ligase screen reveals substrate exclusivity and redundancies.
papers.translated_title: 动态蛋白质组学HECT E3连接酶筛选揭示底物排他性与冗余性。
papers.author: Parmar, B. S.
papers.summary: Cells maintain proteostasis through constant purge of proteins, complexes and large assemblies via the ubiquitin proteasome system (UPS). As a catalyst of ubiquitin transfer, E3 ligases determine the fate of their substrates, and to an extent, of the cell. Current approaches in identifying E3-substrate pairs largely overlook the dynamic nature of their interaction and the functional implications on cellular proteostasis. To address this, we incorporated a pSILAC-enabled dynamic proteomics into a knockdown (KD) screen for the HECT E3 ligase family. Our approach resolved the protein-level accumulation dynamics in response to HECT E3 KD and revealed extensive UPS-wide redundancy. Interestingly, our data also revealed compensation amongst E3s, as well as compensation of individual protein synthesis rate, in response to KD-induced accumulation. Statistical, machine learning and network analyses revealed unique functional niches and hierarchy of KD response for individual HECT E3s. As a mechanistic proof of principle, we show compensation along HUWE1, HECTD1 and TRIP12 axis with implications on MCL1 turnover and mitochondrial quality control. Overall, we here provide a high-confidence list of putative HECT E3 substrates and dependencies along with the interaction network that can be explored via an interactive tool. Our analysis framework is adaptable to larger protease screens and may positively inform the targeted protein degradation field towards precise therapeutic targets.
papers.translated_summary: 细胞通过泛素蛋白酶体系统（UPS）持续清除蛋白质、复合物和大分子组装体来维持蛋白质稳态。作为泛素转移的催化剂，E3连接酶决定其底物的命运，并在一定程度上决定细胞的命运。目前鉴定E3-底物配对的方法在很大程度上忽视了其相互作用的动态性质以及对细胞蛋白质稳态的功能影响。为解决这一问题，我们将基于pSILAC的动态蛋白质组学整合到HECT E3连接酶家族的敲低（KD）筛选中。我们的方法解析了响应HECT E3 KD的蛋白质水平积累动态，并揭示了广泛的UPS层面冗余性。有趣的是，我们的数据还揭示了E3之间的补偿，以及响应KD诱导的积累而发生的个体蛋白质合成速率的补偿。统计分析、机器学习和网络分析揭示了各个HECT E3独特的功能生态位和KD响应的层级关系。作为机制性原理验证，我们展示了沿HUWE1、HECTD1和TRIP12轴的补偿及其对MCL1周转和线粒体质量控制的影响。总体而言，我们在此提供了一份高置信度的推定HECT E3底物及其依赖性列表，以及可通过交互式工具探索的相互作用网络。我们的分析框架可适用于更大规模的蛋白酶筛选，并可能为靶向蛋白质降解领域提供积极信息，助力精准治疗靶点的发现。

papers.title: Evaluation of the Biological Effects and Specificity of the Novel Dihydroceramide Desaturase 1 inhibitor PR280 and its analogues
papers.translated_title: 新型二氢神经酰胺去饱和酶1抑制剂PR280及其类似物的生物学效应与特异性评价
papers.author: Peperno, D. M.
papers.summary: Emerging evidence suggests that dihydroceramide desaturase (DES1) plays key roles in many cellular biologies and pathologies, underscoring a need for DES1 inhibitors, both as research tools and potential therapeutic agents. In this study, we have evaluated the recently reported novel DES1 inhibitor PR280 and its newly synthesized analog PR280b. We find that while both compounds are potent in vitro and in situ DES1 inhibitors, they induced broader changes in cellular sphingolipids, most notably increased ceramide levels, that go beyond DES1 inhibition and had modest effects on DES1-driven biologies including anchorage-independent survival, apoptosis, and autophagy. Overall, although this limits the direct utility of PR280 as a specific DES1 inhibitor, this highlights the potential of this scaffold for further inhibitor development aimed at maintaining the DES1 inhibitory activity while reducing off-target effects.
papers.translated_summary: 新出现的证据表明，二氢神经酰胺去饱和酶（DES1）在多种细胞生物学和病理学过程中发挥关键作用，这凸显了开发DES1抑制剂的必要性，既可作为研究工具，也可作为潜在的治疗药物。在本研究中，我们评估了近期报道的新型DES1抑制剂PR280及其新合成的类似物PR280b。我们发现，虽然这两种化合物在体外和原位均是强效的DES1抑制剂，但它们引起了细胞鞘脂类的广泛变化，最显著的是神经酰胺水平升高，这些变化超出了DES1抑制的范围，并对DES1驱动的生物学过程（包括锚定非依赖性存活、凋亡和自噬）产生了适度的影响。总体而言，尽管这限制了PR280作为特异性DES1抑制剂的直接应用价值，但这也凸显了该骨架在进一步抑制剂开发中的潜力，目标是在保持DES1抑制活性的同时减少脱靶效应。

papers.title: Nanoscale architecture of malaria sporozoite formation
papers.translated_title: 疟原虫孢子子形成的纳米级结构
papers.author: Du, E. W.
papers.summary: Plasmodium falciparum parasites rapidly form thousands of infectious daughter cells, called sporozoites, within single oocysts during their development in the mosquito midgut. How parasites accurately compartmentalize these daughter cells remains poorly understood, mostly due to the exceedingly large oocyst volume (circa 113,000 m3 at the peak of sporozoite segmentation) and the substantial number of cells (5,000-10,000 sporozoites) hampering detailed ultrastructural studies. Here, we use a pre-commercial focused ion beam-scanning electron microscopy platform and custom-trained deep learning models to reconstruct at nanometer resolution the overarching cellular ultrastructure of two oocysts during mid- and late sporozoite formation. We unveil a highly synchronous segmentation process occurring with a striking degree of accuracy and reconstruct faithful stepwise interactions between key organelles in the different growth phases that likely ensure the fidelity of organellar segregation. We discover that sporozoites release membrane-bound cytoplasmic droplets, possibly to refine cell shape in preparation for their motility that drives transmission to humans. Contrary to previous assumptions, in both stages we conclusively visualize a single, interconnected sporoblast which we reason may help precisely coordinate signaling events that drive daughter cell formation. Our study provides foundational insight at unprecedented resolution into the ultrastructural features and changes characterizing the segmentation of P. falciparum sporozoites, conceivably the deadliest unicellular organisms in human history.
papers.translated_summary: 恶性疟原虫寄生虫在蚊中肠发育过程中，于单个卵囊内迅速形成数千个具有感染性的子细胞，称为子孢子。寄生虫如何精确地将这些子细胞区室化，目前仍知之甚少，主要原因是卵囊体积极其巨大（在子孢子分节高峰期约为113,000 m3），且细胞数量众多（5,000-10,000个子孢子），阻碍了详细的超微结构研究。在此，我们使用一个商业化前的聚焦离子束-扫描电子显微镜平台和自定义训练的深度学习模型，以纳米分辨率重建了子孢子形成中期和晚期两个卵囊的整体细胞超微结构。我们揭示了一个高度同步的分节过程，其准确性令人瞩目，并重建了不同生长阶段关键细胞器之间忠实的逐步相互作用，这些相互作用很可能确保了细胞器分离的保真度。我们发现子孢子释放膜结合的细胞质液滴，可能是为了精修细胞形状，为其驱动向人类传播的运动性做准备。与先前的假设相反，在两个阶段中我们都确凿地可视化了一个单一的、相互连接的孢子母细胞，我们认为这可能有助于精确协调驱动子细胞形成的信号事件。我们的研究以空前的分辨率提供了关于恶性疟原虫子孢子分节所特有的超微结构特征和变化的基础性认识，恶性疟原虫可以说是人类历史上最致命的单细胞生物。

papers.title: Synaptojanin 2 is required for neuronal mRNA localization, mitochondrial structure and function, and synaptic metabolism
papers.translated_title: Synaptojanin 2 是神经元 mRNA 定位、线粒体结构与功能以及突触代谢所必需的
papers.author: Gibbs, W.
papers.summary: Neurons rely on local mRNA transport to support the metabolic and structural demands of their distal compartments. Synaptojanin 2a (Synj2a), a mitochondria-associated phosphoinositide phosphatase, binds numerous mitochondrial mRNAs via an RNA recognition motif (RRM) and delivers them to axons and dendrites. Among these, PINK1 mRNA transport is particularly critical for mitochondrial quality control. Here we show that this RNA transport function, independent of Synj2s catalytic activity, is required for PINK1-dependent mitochondrial quality control, synaptic bioenergetics, and neuronal resilience. We made mice and human iPSC-derived neurons carrying RRM point mutations that disrupt RNA binding while preserving both phosphatase domains. The mutations also reduced endogenous Synj2 protein levels, indicating that RNA binding contributes to Synj2 stability. Rescue experiments with the RRM targeted to the outer mitochondrial membrane were therefore necessary to isolate which effects are due to RNA-binding. Neurons with the mutated RRM failed to localize PINK1 mRNA to neurites. Consequently, depolarizing mitochondria in these neurites failed to stabilize PINK1 protein or cause phosphoubiquitin to accumulate on mitochondria. Re-expressing the RRM rescued these defects, confirming that RNA-binding rather than phosphatase activity drives the phenotype. Mutant mice showed abnormal mitochondrial cristae ultrastructure and reduced respiratory capacity in synaptosomes. Metabolic profiling revealed extensive reprogramming, most notably increased glycolytic flux, elevated branched-chain amino acids and reduced cholesterol. Despite compensatory reprogramming, mutant neurons showed heightened vulnerability to mitochondrial and excitotoxic stress. This vulnerability was partially rescued by the mitochondrially-targeted RRM. These findings establish Synj2-mediated mRNA transport as a significant mechanism that supports mitochondrial homeostasis.
papers.translated_summary: 神经元依赖局部mRNA运输来满足其远端区室的代谢和结构需求。突触短杆蛋白2a（Synj2a）是一种与线粒体相关的磷酸肌醇磷酸酶，通过RNA识别基序（RRM）结合多种线粒体mRNA，并将它们运送至轴突和树突。其中，PINK1 mRNA的运输对线粒体质量控制尤为关键。本研究表明，这种不依赖Synj2s催化活性的RNA运输功能，是PINK1依赖性线粒体质量控制、突触生物能量学和神经元韧性所必需的。我们构建了携带RRM点突变的小鼠和人类iPSC来源神经元，这些突变破坏了RNA结合，同时保留了两个磷酸酶结构域。这些突变还降低了内源性Synj2蛋白水平，表明RNA结合有助于Synj2的稳定性。因此，必须进行将RRM靶向至线粒体外膜的拯救实验，以分离出哪些效应是由RNA结合引起的。携带突变RRM的神经元未能将PINK1 mRNA定位至神经突。因此，在这些神经突中去极化线粒体未能稳定PINK1蛋白或导致磷酸泛素在线粒体上积累。重新表达RRM可挽救这些缺陷，证实是RNA结合而非磷酸酶活性驱动了该表型。突变小鼠表现出异常的线粒体嵴超微结构和突触体中降低的呼吸能力。代谢谱分析揭示了广泛的重编程，最显著的是糖酵解通量增加、支链氨基酸升高和胆固醇降低。尽管存在代偿性重编程，突变神经元对线粒体和兴奋性毒性应激表现出更高的脆弱性。这种脆弱性被靶向线粒体的RRM部分挽救。这些发现确立了Synj2介导的mRNA运输作为支持线粒体稳态的重要机制。

papers.title: Protocol for generating 3D mesenchymal stromal cell spheroids using serum-free medium and differentiating them into endothelial-like Cells
papers.translated_title: 使用无血清培养基生成3D间充质基质细胞球体并将其分化为内皮样细胞的方案
papers.author: Li, S.
papers.summary: Three-dimensional (3D) cultures of mesenchymal stromal cells (MSC) replicate in vivo conditions more accurately than two-dimensional (2D) cultures. This protocol outlines a simple and cost-efficient approach for generating mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) spheroids, which typically form within 1-3 days and are suitable for endothelial differentiation. Accutase can be applied to dissociate the spheroids into single cells for downstream analysis. A combination of growth factors is used to induce the differentiation of MSC spheroids into endothelial-like structures, which express key endothelial markers such as von Willebrand factor (vWF) and CD31, as confirmed by immunofluorescence.
papers.translated_summary: 间充质基质细胞（MSC）的三维（3D）培养比二维（2D）培养更准确地模拟体内条件。本方案概述了一种简单且经济高效的方法，用于生成间充质基质细胞（MSC）球体，这些球体通常在1-3天内形成，适用于内皮分化。可应用Accutase将球体解离为单细胞，以便进行下游分析。使用生长因子的组合来诱导MSC球体分化为内皮样结构，这些结构表达关键的内皮标志物，如血管性血友病因子（vWF）和CD31，并经免疫荧光证实。

papers.title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa lectins LecA and LecB differentially engage and activate the EphA2 receptor
papers.translated_title: 铜绿假单胞菌凝集素LecA和LecB差异性地结合并激活EphA2受体
papers.author: Senin, C.
papers.summary: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a critical nosocomial pathogen responsible for severe and often difficult-to-treat infections in humans. Despite their central role in early host-pathogen interactions, the carbohydrate-binding lectins LecA and LecB remain largely underexplored compared to other P. aeruginosa virulence factors. Here, we show that LecA and LecB activate the human receptor tyrosine kinase EphA2 in a time- and carbohydrate-dependent manner in lung epithelial cells. Whereas LecB directly engages EphA2 primarily through protein-glycan binding, LecA activates EphA2 indirectly via interactions with the glycosphingolipid Gb3. Both lectins strongly colocalize with EphA2 at the host plasma membrane and trigger downstream CrkII phosphorylation via canonical EphA2 signaling. Owing to their tetravalent nature, LecA and LecB can cross-link membrane receptors, driving lateral membrane reorganization that initiates downstream signaling. Moreover, simultaneous engagement of both lectins at the plasma membrane further potentiates EphA2 activation. Finally, we demonstrate that live P. aeruginosa preferentially adheres to membrane domains where EphA2 concomitantly accumulates, inducing receptor activation in host cells. Collectively, these findings identify EphA2 as a pivotal host receptor mediating LecA- and LecB-driven signal transduction and provide new mechanistic insights into how P. aeruginosa exploits human lung epithelial cells during infection.
papers.translated_summary: 铜绿假单胞菌是一种重要的医院获得性病原体，可引起人类严重且往往难以治疗的感染。尽管碳水化合物结合凝集素LecA和LecB在早期宿主-病原体相互作用中发挥核心作用，但与其他铜绿假单胞菌毒力因子相比，它们仍很大程度上未被充分研究。本研究表明，LecA和LecB以时间和碳水化合物依赖的方式激活肺上皮细胞中的人受体酪氨酸激酶EphA2。LecB主要通过蛋白质-聚糖结合直接与EphA2相互作用，而LecA则通过与糖鞘脂Gb3的相互作用间接激活EphA2。两种凝集素均与宿主质膜上的EphA2强烈共定位，并通过经典的EphA2信号传导触发下游CrkII磷酸化。由于其四价性质，LecA和LecB能够交联膜受体，驱动侧向膜重组，从而启动下游信号传导。此外，两种凝集素在质膜上的同时结合进一步增强EphA2的激活。最后，我们证明活铜绿假单胞菌优先黏附于EphA2同时聚集的膜结构域，诱导宿主细胞中的受体激活。总之，这些发现确定EphA2是介导LecA和LecB驱动信号转导的关键宿主受体，并为铜绿假单胞菌在感染过程中如何利用人肺上皮细胞提供了新的机制见解。
